contracts.contract: Browsing/status/filtering creates zero sessions/writes. Concurrent assignment has one winner. Unknown host, alias collision, second executing target and stale home/subject refuse without effect

Explicit high survives save/reload and reservation. Catalog/provider/mode/thinking mismatch refuses with no fallback. Drift and mid-turn change preserve old attribution; queued change creates no effect until checked replacement

Wrong old identity, idle-only proof, unavailable host, insufficient cumulative cap and uncertain prior send refuse. Exact stopped predecessor plus retained checkpoint yields one next epoch/opening; crash replay never creates another

Missing read-only capability yields zero inspector creation. Qualified synthetic adapter has independent cwd, no parent, restricted tools and immutable own profile; config change cannot make an inspector executable
Profile, source or policy changes at final guard hold. Plan approval and watch assignment never allow merge/deploy/discard, remote workers or another plan's budget

100 unchanged typed waits/healthy observations produce zero owner/General/inspector model sends. A→B→A preserves three transitions; due deadline, changed policy, exact answer or new captain instruction is not swallowed

contracts.contract: Expired evidence, incomplete coverage, failed dependency, unhandled result, malformed wait and unknown effect cannot disappear behind identical text/backlog hash; no repeated action or duplicate captain question

contracts.contract: Restart at each watch-route prepare/drain/commit/send boundary preserves one authoritative route, exact pending entries and uncertainty. Overlapping watches cannot produce two execution owners; source rename/digest change requires review

contracts.contract: Two production-composed local chains advance while General's conversation lifecycle lock is held; stall one owner receiver and the other advances. Captain queue stays one-per-completed-turn with no background interruption

Replay identical input schedule against existing runtime and proposed path; count unique operation effects, openings, owner/inspector/worker turns and unknowns. New controls add no paid status turns; unknown token/billing values stay unknown

Both entry points use same captured target and review. Wide 1440/compact 390, both themes, no overflow; automatic screenshot comparison with stage 1's frozen native fixture. Stale/uncertain/disabled/config-pending states and keyboard navigation included

Old journal/config/inspection history replay unchanged; removed spending remains counted. Disable/pause does not erase effects or reactivate old route. Corrupt/missing records hold only appropriate scope without lying about totals
